title: Product UI
line: A light, soft-shadowed product moment: the app's own interface floats in gentle 3D, a cursor does the one thing the feature does, the result lands with a toast.
bestFor: before and after inside the app

beats.visual: A white app window tilts up into place in soft 3D; transcript words sit in chips, two fillers in amber.
A cursor glides to um, presses it; the chip dims and strikes through.

beats.say: It is gone, and the sentence closes up.
beats.visual: The struck chips shrink to nothing and the remaining words slide together.
A dark toast slides up: 2 fillers removed; the window settles with a slow push.
